hints.title: Complement Subarray Problem
hints.text: Taking characters from the left and right borders leaves a contiguous middle subarray untouched.

hints.title: Middle Subarray Upper Bound
hints.text: If total count of a character is total_c, the middle subarray can retain at most total_c - k of that character.

hints.title: Sliding Window Maximization
hints.text: Find the maximum length of a contiguous subarray that satisfies the retention limits for 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

hints.title: Complement Window Optimization Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pointer sliding window over alphabet of size 3.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all prefixes and suffixes takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space for 3 character counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inverts the problem to find the longest valid subarray to leave in the middle.
